data.content:
The hosts will be without midfielder Asen Mitkov and experienced forward Radoslav Kirilov, who are both unavailable through injury, but Velazquez will be determined to take advantage of a rare opportunity to play at home after six successive away fixtures.

Jagiellonia, on the other hand, have experienced a change in fortunes after a miserable September and October, with Adrian Siemieniec's men now enjoying a three-match winning streak across all competitions. [...] The Bulgarian champions have found consistency under Julio Velazquez, while their Polish counterparts arrive with renewed confidence after putting together three successive wins.

There should be plenty of attacking quality on display too, with both sides boasting forwards in good scoring form.

Read our prediction, preview and betting tips for the game below, and make sure to check out our today's betting tips page for more of our expert predictions. [...] Prelec has already registered nine goal contributions since arriving in Bialystok, and Jagiellonia will hope the in-form forward can help them secure a first victory against Bulgarian opposition while breathing new life into their European ambitions.
